title: Deshaun Watson Avoids Criticism in Cleveland Return
seoTitle: Deshaun Watson's Return to Cleveland Avoids Criticism
subtitle: Quarterback avoids boos in first home drive since 2024
excerpt: Returning to Cleveland after injury, Watson did not receive an ovation when he took the field for the first time since 2024.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Deshaun Watson returned to play in Cleveland after suffering an Achilles tendon in 2024, but the crowd did not greet him with applause. In his first home drive, the reaction was more subdued, shifting only when Watson managed to move the team forward.

Fan Reaction to Watson's Return

When Watson entered Huntington Bank Field, the initial crowd reaction was quieter than the last time he played in 2024. The shift in tone occurred when he managed to advance the team on two plays, prompting the crowd to applaud.

Watson's Performance on the First Drive

On the first drive, Watson had two runs totaling 12 yards, avoiding a sack and advancing the team 12 yards on third down. However, the drive stalled on fourth down, with two incomplete passes followed by a 7-yard check-down, leaving the team without a score.

Comparison with Previous Games

Watson's return followed the Browns' victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in the second round. In comparison, the team struggled in the first round against the Jacksonville Jaguars, showing a noticeable improvement in their second outing.

Impact of Return on the Game Against the Panthers

Sunday's game against the Carolina Panthers was seen as an opportunity for Watson to demonstrate his progress. The Browns, ranked 31st in rushing offense, relied on Watson to improve their on-field performance. Meanwhile, the Panthers boast the league's weakest run defense.

Expectations for the Next Game

Analysts at Dawgs By Nature suggest that Watson can continue to improve, but questions about his consistency remain. The expectation is that he will continue to drive the Browns' offense, especially in short-yardage situations.

Information from NBC Sports, Dawgs By Nature.
